annotations.title: Add a class to the timetable

description: Add a class (lesson) to the user's timetable in DayHeart: one class, or the same class every week or every other week (for alternating weeks) until a date. It goes into a place of study; in a shared group place the whole group gets it. Look and room, teacher and link come from an existing class of the same subject in that place when there is one. The same class at the same day and time is not added twice.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the (first) day of the class

kind.description: Kind of class: lecture, practice, lab or seminar

place.description: Place of study (group) name; needed only when the user has several

room.description: Room or building, as the user writes it

subject.description: Subject, as it should appear, e.g. "Anatomy (Pr)"

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD: last day for weekly or biweekly; at most 90 classes

name: add_class
title: Add a class to the timetable
